question: How are Sadashiva's powers arranged in the Sadakhya world?
premises: In the Sadakhya world dwells the god Sadashiva.
His knowledge and action are on his left and right.
His supreme will is the power resting in his lap.
inference: Sadashiva's threefold power is spatially arranged as knowledge, action, and supreme will.
plain_english: In that world dwells the god Sadashiva. His powers of knowledge and action are on his left and right, while his supreme will rests in his lap.
